name: Regional services country multiplier (AllowRegionalPricing, LIST channel only)
what_it_tests: A services line with AllowRegionalPricing__c=true applies the country multiplier to the LIST channel (CEILING(List x mult /5)x5) while NET stays catalog, producing a structural TotalLineAmount != NetTotalPrice; applies on new quote + amendment, NOT renewal
proc_mechanism: RegionalServicesPricingPrehook reads Services_Regional_Pricing__mdt (e.g. Italy 0.64, India 0.4, LATAM 0.5); RegionalServicesPrice27 assignment RegionalNetUnitPrice__c -> InputUnitPrice (list channel)
expected_behavior: List/TotalLineAmount scaled by regional multiplier and rounded to nearest 5; NetTotalPrice from catalog (structural list!=net) per documented design
test_setup: Services line, AllowRegionalPricing__c=true, Italy (0.64) catalog 2400 -> 1540, or India 0.4 list 1000 -> 400; Qty=1, new/amend

prior_run.actual: Repriced (V21, Force, REST place), STABLE across 3 repricings on Italy fixture 0Q0WC000003FYdx0AG: ListPrice=55000, UnitPrice=35200, TotalLineAmount=35200 (multiplier correct), but NetUnitPrice=35200 AND NetTotalPrice=35200 (net reconciled to regional, NOT 55000). list==net==35200, not list!=net. Regional_NetUnit_Price__c=35200.
prior_run.defectStep: Regional Services Price (RegionalServicesPricingPrehook v13.3 UnitPrice write) + absent V9 LIST-only isolation
